Thanks Laura — quick read-through and initial redline plan below. I pushed comments into the MSA (tracked) and flagged three items that will materially affect negotiation timeline:

1) Indemnity & caps: counterparty requests a mutual indemnity but leaves out an explicit cap for data breach liability. Recommend we propose mutual indemnity with a $5M cap for commercial customers, and carve out willful misconduct.

2) Data residency / sub-processing: MSA has an appendix referencing EU customers but no specific subprocessor disclosure. We should request their list of subprocessors and propose standard Exhibit D (subprocessors + data processing addendum). Karthik — if they will operate EU workloads, we may need to note cross-border transfer language.

3) SLA & credits: Proposed SLA is 99.5% monthly. Suggest we accept 99.5% but tighten MTTR definition and limit credits to service fees for affected period.

Questions for the buyer (to include in our reply):
- Can you confirm the exact legal entity that will sign (name, jurisdiction)? The Order Form indicates NovaNet, Inc. but signatory block is blank.
- Who is the billing contact and PO process — do they require purchase orders or invoicing to a reseller?

Next steps / owners:
- I will send back tracked MSA with comment summary and a short redline memo by EOD tomorrow (Tue 4/6).
- Marissa — please draft the MAP and include the contracting milestones (contract counter, signature, SSO provisioning, integration test window).
- Laura — if procurement has any pricing/discount asks, share so we can include commercial fallback.
